philosophy.title: Central Control Plane in Your Environment
philosophy.description: Swarm Agentic Lab is not a traditional SaaS platform. Our mission is to help organizations replace fragmented SaaS workflows with autonomous agent systems that run within their own environment. We deploy the AI control plane, not another model server.

governed_deployment.description: Swarm Agentic Lab does not require public SaaS hosting. All components operate inside your controlled infrastructure.

on_prem.title: On-Prem
on_prem.description: GPU servers in your data centre. Full control, zero external dependencies. Recommended for regulated industries and air-gapped requirements. Runs on VMware, OpenStack, or Proxmox.

private_cloud.title: Private Cloud
private_cloud.description: AWS, Azure, or GCP — deployed inside your VPC. No data leaves your cloud account. Supports GPU instance types across all major providers.

self_hosted_private_cloud.title: Self-Hosted Private Cloud
self_hosted_private_cloud.description: VMware, OpenStack, or Proxmox on your existing data centre infrastructure. Swarm Agentic Lab deploys via Docker Compose or Kubernetes.

hybrid.title: Hybrid
hybrid.description: On-prem inference combined with cloud integrations. Run your models on owned hardware while connecting to cloud-based storage or services.

tier_2_production_enterprise.target_workload: Medium operational fleet (15-20 concurrent active agents)

tier_3_hyper_scale_swarms.recommended_gpu: 8x NVIDIA H100 or H200 Nodes (80GB / 141GB VRAM)

pricing_philosophy.heading: Why pricing starts with scope, not seats.
pricing_philosophy.description: Swarm Agentic Lab rejects public per-user licensing and token-only billing models. Because governed AI deployments depend heavily on your unique infrastructure profile, GPU provisioning, concurrent traffic patterns, memory partitions, compliance frameworks, validation layers, and SLA guarantees, we tailormake every installation scope. The architectural foundation remains consistent, while the final investment is optimized directly for your specific operating environment.

budgeting_guidance.description: Most enterprise integrations begin with a readiness diagnostic or a proof-of-concept pilot before transitioning to annual platform subscriptions. Underlying infrastructure costs (dedicated GPU clusters, cloud storage hosts, VPC networking interfaces) remain completely separate and are managed directly within your customer accounts.

data_residency: No training on customer data without explicit agreement
SAML SSO and OIDC integrations available based on deployment requirements

compliance.description: Compliance requirements vary by customer environment and deployment architecture. Because Swarm is designed to operate within customer-controlled infrastructure, security, governance, and compliance controls can align with your organization's existing requirements and policies. All agents developed will undergo all compliance standards across the globe and pass it eventually. Furthermore, you can build your own custom compliance agents for your organization to enforce internal standards.
